prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original medieval grounded RPG LOW RES PIXEL ART location concept, elevated three-quarter cutaway. Coarse square pixel clusters, controlled dark outlines, restrained 3-tone stone timber wool iron, muted earth palette, no smooth painted surfaces or photorealism. No people, no text or labels, no quest UI, no magic, no outcome animation. Daylight. Room/prop geometry is a proposal, not certified collision, official geography, inventory or narrative outcome. Open ordinary return path remains visually distinct. One small landward dockworkers rope shed. Cutaway wooden roof above two CLEARLY SEPARATED sets of ordinary suspended rope tallies: on left several rope loops each bearing one small blank wood tag; on right a separate hook with two square cargo tally tags. Do not put ropes around people or render prison chains. A low comparison table is empty. A raised cargo boardwalk and lower side footpath run parallel outside; the broad dry landward exit never requires entering water or boarding a boat. Harbour beyond is only a narrow context strip, no whole city. Weathered dark oak, rope ochre, stone grey, dull blue water. No debtor imprisoned, freed, paid or assigned labor.
